_about: Public-domain Humphrey Prideaux (1648-1724), Dean of Norwich, orientalist and church historian, for the Word Hoard: The Old and New Testament Connected in the History of the Jews and Neighbouring Nations (ninth edition, 4 vols., 1725), The Validity of the Orders of the Church of England (1688), The True Nature of Imposture Fully Display'd in the Life of Mahomet (1698), A Letter to the Deists (1696), The Original and Right of Tithes (1710) and Directions to Church-Wardens (second edition, 1704). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 68 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

prideaux-connection-1725-v1: The Old and New Testament Connected in the History of the Jews and Neighbouring Nations, Part I, vol. 1, ninth edition (London: R. Knaplock and J. Tonson, 1725)
prideaux-connection-1725-v2: The Old and New Testament Connected in the History of the Jews and Neighbouring Nations, Part I, vol. 2, ninth edition (London: R. Knaplock and J. Tonson, 1725)
prideaux-connection-1725-v3: The Old and New Testament Connected in the History of the Jews and Neighbouring Nations, Part II, vol. 3, ninth edition (London: R. Knaplock and J. Tonson, 1725)
prideaux-connection-1725-v4: The Old and New Testament Connected in the History of the Jews and Neighbouring Nations, Part II, vol. 4, ninth edition (London: R. Knaplock and J. Tonson, 1725)
prideaux-validity-orders-1688: The Validity of the Orders of the Church of England, made out against the objections of the Papists (London: Aylmer, 1688)
prideaux-imposture-mahomet-1698: The True Nature of Imposture Fully Display'd in the Life of Mahomet (London: Rogers, 1698)
prideaux-tithes-1710: The Original and Right of Tithes, for the Maintenance of the Ministry in a Christian Church Truly Stated (Norwich: Fr. Collins, 1710)
prideaux-church-wardens-1704: Directions to Church-Wardens for the Faithful Discharge of their Office, second edition (Norwich, 1704)

_excluded.prideaux-other: Marmora Oxoniensia (Latin, 1676); French and Dutch translations of the Connection; the many later printings of the Connection (1716-1749 folio and octavo, 1749 Google copies), duplicates of the 1725 set shelved
